header_sentences: See Sanctify, Sanctuary; and see Anthony of Padua, Fear, Proceed, Seven, and Tent.

contexts.text: Holiness, and justice = what is celestial (as distinguished from what is spiritual) of faith.

They who had supposed themselves saints are in the Lower Earth before the left foot, where they sometimes appear to themselves to have shining faces, which flows forth from their ideas of their holiness... They are kept there in the most intense desire to ascend into Heaven... which is turned more and more into anxiety... until they acknowledge that they are not saints. When they are taken out, it is given them to smell their own stench... SE 3651. SE 3652.
A certain one supposed he had lived holily because he had been esteemed as holy by men... He said he had merely lived holily... He became black...
Under Babel, see this reference.
What is holy can never be with what is profane...
Hence Canaan is called the Holy Land.

This childish state is holy, because innocent. Ignorance does not take away holiness when there is innocence in it; for holiness dwells in the ignorance which is innocent. With all men, except the Lord, holiness can dwell only in ignorance... With the Angels themselves... holiness also dwells in ignorance; for they know and acknowledge that they know nothing of themselves... He who does not acknowledge (this) cannot be in the holiness of ignorance in which are the Angels.

The holiness of ignorance does not consist in being more ignorant than others, but in the acknowledgement that of himself a man knows nothing... especially in his regarding scientific and intellectual things as of small account relatively to... the things of life.
So often seen by the saints.
Those within the Church can render impure holy things themselves...
(These) especially profane holy things...
Under Tent, see this reference. AC 2190.
Holiness is never predicated except from love and charity; not from faith, except in proportion to the love and charity there is in the truths of faith... AC 2343:end.
Therefore they were commanded to eat it in a holy place; and hence it is called the holy of holies. AC 2177:8. AC 2342:end.
What is once implanted from infancy as holy... unless contrary to order, the Lord never breaks, but bends.
All good is called holy, because it is of love and charity, which are from the Lord alone...
Myriads... of his thoughts about the goods and truths of faith... are in his Holy...
Only when man is in a holy state...
From both is the Holy which fills the universal Heaven.
How holy the Word is. Explained. DSS 3, Explained.
There is not anything holy which does not proceed from the Lord.
The Holy Itself of His Divine Human was the vesture which appeared as the light...
Under Shekel, see this reference.
With him who is in what is holy when he is reading the Word... AC 3424:2. AC 4279:2.
The Holy One of Israel is the Lord Himself.
If man would think, when in what is holy... AC 3735:2.
They at once have an idea of what is holy, which gives a universal confirmation...
This order is the Holy which affects him.

To do violence to the internal sense is to deny the things which are... the holy things themselves of the Word, which are, the Lord's Divine Human, love to Him, and love towards the neighbour. These three are... also the internal and holy things of all doctrinals from the Word, and... of all worship...

Standing in the holy place () = vastation as to all things of good and truth. The holy place = the state of love and faith... The holy of this state is the good of love and the derivative truth of faith: nothing else is meant by Holy in the Word, because these are from the Lord, who is the Holy Itself, or the Sanctuary.

The Royalty itself and the Priesthood itself are holy, whatever be the quality of him who ministers. (AC 4311:3, Explained.) Hence the Word which an evil person teaches is equally holy... Hence, too, no king can at all claim anything of the Holy of his royalty; nor any priest anything of the Holy of his priesthood...
The Holy itself, which is then with the man, is from the influx of celestial and spiritual thoughts and affections...
A state of too much heat... is a holy external, when within is the love of self and of the world.
Hence it is evident how holy the Word is; for in the Divine love, or in love from the Divine, there is holiness...
Holy assiduity. Signified, Explained.
Love to the Lord is the Holy itself.
Are easily seduced by external sanctities.
In holy external worship, and profane internal.
In holy external, but interiorly in falsity.
The Holy of faith. Signified. (by Daniel) AC 3923.
The Holy, which is good, corresponds to the Divine mercy.
Although... he can be with others in what is holy...
The Divine holiness which pertained to Him, Signified.
Justice... when said of the Lord, = the Divine holiness; for all spiritual and celestial good proceeds from the Lord's Divine holiness.
Delight flows in... when he is reading these things, and still more when he believes what is holy to be in them.
Whatever forces man... if it instils any affection... appears to infuse something holy... but when the state is changed... he conjoins that Holy with evils and falsities, and it is made profane...
What is holy. Signified.
Whatever proceeds from the Lord is holy.
What is holy of truth. Signified.
That in their holy things there were not such truths. Signified.
What is holy of that truth. Signified, Explained.

All truth which is from the Divine is in what is holy... because the truth which is from the Divine is holy. It is called holy from the affection... which inflows from the Lord, and causes the man to be affected with truth.
The Holy which is from the Lord has in it Divine good and Divine truth...
Bread, in the supreme sense, = the Lord; therefore it = all that is holy from Him, that is, all good and truth.
When man is in what is holy while he is eating (the Holy Supper). AC 4217:2.
When the Lord's Human is thought of, if there is holiness in the idea, the Holy which from the Lord fills Heaven is also thought of, thus also Heaven...
One can think of the Lord's Human more holily than another...

Those in the most holy idea of the Lord... are conjoined with Him as to His Divine Rational. They who are not in such holiness... are conjoined with Him as to His Divine Natural. They who have a still grosser holiness are conjoined with Him as to His Divine Sensuous.
This with variety according to the holiness in which he is, not only as to thought, but also as to affection.
The camp of the saints () = Heaven, or the Lord's Kingdom on earth, which is the Church.
a. The Holy of preparation and arrangement. Signified.
But here there is signified the Holy which proceeds from the Divine, for everything holy is thence. The reason what is holy is signified, is...
In order that a representative of the Church might come forth when they were in a holy external; otherwise they would have profaned holy things.
More than other nations they could be held in a holy external without any holy internal... AC 4293:4.

The Jews had no idea of Jehovah... that He was most holy, because they did not know what holiness was, still less could they at all see the holy which proceeds from Him, because they were in bodily and earthly love, without a holy internal.
(Such a man) has none but evil Spirits present, even when in a holy external...

It was miraculously provided by the Lord, that when they were in a holy external, and encompassed with evil Spirits, still the Holy in which they were might be elevated into Heaven... Therefore the communication was not given with the man himself, but with the Holy itself... AC 4545:6, Explained.
To these the Holy of worship is beneficial (there); but not to the former.

Booths or tents properly = what is holy of truth; and are distinguished from tabernacles = which are also called tents = by this, that the latter = what is holy of good... What is holy of truth is the good which is from truth. Illustrated.
Holiness to be put on. Signified.
That holy truths were to be put on. Signified.
The holy Natural. Signified.

For, when the Lord made His Human Divine, He first made it holy. The difference between making Divine and making holy is this: the Divine is Jehovah Himself, whereas the Holy is what is from Jehovah...
The Holy of truth in that Divine state. Signified.
The statues for worship were anointed, and then they were holy.
Their descendants... began to think holily of them merely from reverence... At last the posterity... immediately before the Flood... began to sanctify those stones... AC 4580:3.
The Holy is especially predicated of Divine truth; for the Divine is in the Lord, and Divine truth proceeds from Him, and is called the Holy.
Unless these [ceremonies] represented holy things, and, by correspondence with the things of Heaven and the Church, were holy, they would be nothing but plays...

Then rituals were holy, because they represented holy things, and corresponded to the holy things in Heaven and the Church. At this day also they are held to be holy (merely) as emblems which are in use. But if it were known what (these royal insignia) represented... men would think of them much more holily.
Whatever proceeds from Him is holy: the holy which is not from the Divine is not holy.
Shed not blood = that they should not do violence to what is holy.
All the Holy in Heaven proceeds from His Divine Human, and hence all the Holy in the Church; therefore, to prevent its violation, the Holy Supper was instituted...
As blood... = the Divine Spiritual or Divine truth proceeding from His Divine Human, it = the Holy; for (this) is the Holy itself; there is no other Holy... Illustrated.
To appropriate... the Holy which proceeds from His Divine Human. Signified.
This Holy is what is called the Holy Spirit. Illustrated.
Twenty... here, = holy truth.
Here, twenty = what is not holy relatively to those who estranged Divine truth... but what is holy relatively to those who received it...
With those who have no remains of good and truth... what is holy is not holy, but... is either filthy or profane. Illustrated.
All the things (of the Tabernacle) were called holy, and the inmost, the holy of holies... They were not holy in themselves, but were holy from the fact that they represented holy things...

If (the Jews) are told that the Word is holy, nay, most holy, and that every apex there is holy, they acknowledge it... from such a lust; for they believe it to be holy in the letter, and not that what is holy inflows through it...

If told that many mentioned in the Word are to be reverenced as saints... they acknowledge it... from a like lust; for they believe that those persons were... holy... when yet their Holy is from... their representing the Lord, and a representative Holy does not at all affect the person.

If told that the ark. Temple, etc., were holy, they acknowledge it... from this lust; for they believe these things to have been holy in themselves... and this interiorly, because... the holiness of Jehovah... was actually in them... But what is holy is in good and truth alone... thus solely... in the men who receive these things from the Lord.

Those in spiritual natural truth hold as an ultimate truth that those things were holy which are called holy;as the ark, etc... but still have the idea, that they were not holy in themselves, nor was any holiness infused into them, but they were holy representatively...
In the Spiritual Church it = the Holy of faith from charity; but in the Celestial Church it = the Holy of charity from love to the Lord.
The falsity which they veil over with holiness. Signified.
The Angels... are affected with the holy things which are communicated to the man who reads the Word from affection; whence he also has what is holy.
The Holy which is sometimes apperceived by a man when reading the Word, has in it many such arcana...
They feared = what is holy...
The Holy which then inflows, induces something of fear, with holy reverence.
No one is forced away from his Holy.
The light thence is the Holy of love...
The holy things of that Church. Signified.
Thought about the holy things of the Church. Signified.

The holy things here signified by daughters are truths: these are called holy, because the truths which become of faith are from good; and because what proceeds... is the Divine truth from the Divine good. Hence the Holy Spirit is the Holy which proceeds... for the Spirit itself does not proceed, but the Holy which the Spirit speaks...
That Holy is said of Divine truth. Illustrated.
The internal of the Word inflows... when the man regards the Word as holy, which he does when he is in good.
Ground of holiness () = the Holy which proceeds from the Lord; thus it = the state of the Holy which proceeds from His Divine Human.
The Holy proceeding from His Human by which infesting falsities would be dissipated. Signified.
For the Holy which proceeds from the Lord not only dissipates infesting falsities, but also reduces all things into Divine order...
The evil of (the worship of saints) is evil of falsity.
Under Blood, see this reference. AC 7326.
Thus is extinguished the Holy of worship.
By them they are called saints. (In Jupiter.) AC 8735. Described. AC 8736. AC 8739.
To a holy state. Signified.
Fourteen, like seven = what is holy.
Therefore, on the first day... there was to be a holy convocation, and on the twenty-first day a holy convocation.
Who is like unto Thee, in holiness? () = that from Him is all that is holy...
By the Holy is meant the Divine truth proceeding from Him; this is called holy, and is meant by the Holy Spirit, which is therefore called the Spirit of Truth.

As holiness is predicated of the Divine truth... the Angels, who receive it, are called holy. Illustrated. So are the prophets, and especially the Word... The Lord, also, from the Divine truth... is called the Holy One of Israel, the Holy One of Jacob, and the Holy One of God. AC 9820:2.
The habitation of Thy holiness () = Heaven where the Divine is; for holiness is predicated of the Divine truth... (which) makes Heaven.
A holy Sabbath to Jehovah... Hence the Sabbath was most holy.
A holy Man () = the Lord...
A holy nation () = the Spiritual Kingdom... Holy is predicated of the truth of good. (References.) Hence a holy nation = the good from which is truth.
Good from the Lord is the holy with them; hence, in proportion as they receive of good from Him, they are holy...
The habitation of holiness = the Heaven of those of the Celestial Kingdom... AC 9815:2.
The Holy of the Lord with man cannot be violated, thus neither the man who receives the Holy of the Lord; that is, who is in the good of love, and therefore in Heaven.
Hence are the holiness and life of the Word. AC 8971, Explained. AC 9349, Explained. AC 9405:2.

Men of holiness shall ye be to Me () = the state of life then from good... Men of holiness = those who are led by the Lord; for the Divine which proceeds from Him is the Holy itself. (References.) Hence, they who receive it in faith and also in love are called saints. (AC 9229:6, Illustrated) He who believes that a man is holy from any other source, and that anything else in him is holy than what is from the Lord, and is received, is very greatly mistaken.
That in proportion as a man can be withheld from his own proprium, the Lord can be present; thus in the same proportion there is what is holy with the man. References.
That the Lord is the only Holy One; and only that is holy which proceeds from Him... Illustrated.
Hence, Jerusalem is called holy; and Zion, the mountain of holiness. Illustrated.
The appearing of the dead saints there () = the salvation of those who had been of the Spiritual Church...
The spiritual sense is presented in Heaven when a man is reading the Word holily.
That all truths of good and goods of truth are holy, because from the Lord alone. Representation.

(The Israelites) believed themselves holy if they merely sacrificed or washed themselves... not acknowledging that such things represented the internal holiness which is of charity and faith from the Lord; for nothing holy is of man, but everything holy is of the Lord with man. They who humble themselves from the faith of holiness from self... (do so) from the love of self...

The internal Holy, which is of the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord... inflows into Heaven and is received by the Angels. Mediately through this Holy, and also immediately, there inflows from the Lord a Holy to the good Spirits with the man who is in the reading of the Word or in the derivative worship. This Holy is called the external Holy; and when it inflows with a man it presents representatives according to the correspondences with that man. (Represented by Moses and Joshua.)

When (Moses) came upon the mountain, he first represented the external Holy of the Word, which is what mediates; for that mountain = Heaven where is the Holy; but still he was admitted no further than to the first threshold of Heaven, where the external Holy of the Word ceases. Explained.
Information concerning the holy things of Heaven which were to be represented. Signified.
The Divine truth... is what is called holy, because it proceeds from the Divine good of the Lord's Divine Love... Signified. AC 9820. AC 9930:2.
The Holy of truth from good. Signified.
Divine good is the holy of holies.
When Aaron entered into the Holy of Holies...

Let the veil distinguish for you between the Holy and the Holy of Holies () = between spiritual good... and celestial good... The Holy = the good which reigns in the middle Heaven; and the Holy of Holies = the good which reigns in the Inmost Heaven.

All good is holy; and all truth, in proportion as good is in it. Good is called Holy from the Lord, because the Lord is the only Holy... Hence it is evident why the habitation is called the Holy, and the ark in which was the Testimony, the Holy of Holies ... Explained.

Therefore, whatever... represented the Lord, or the good and truth which proceed from Him, was, after inauguration, called holy, because the Lord alone is holy. The Holy Spirit, also, is the Holy which proceeds from the Lord.
The Holy of Holies () = where is the good of love from the Lord.
Aaron's garments of holiness represented the Divine truths in the Spiritual Kingdom in their order.
The reason the most external is holy above the internal things. Explained.
In his entering into the holy () = in all worship... for the whole of his administration at the altar, and in the Tent... was called the Holy ... AC 9907.

Holiness to Jehovah () = the Lord's Divine Human, and all the celestial and spiritual good thence. Holiness = the Divine which proceeds from the Lord, thus the Lord Himself as to the Divine Human, from which is all the Divine in the Heavens. Hence it is that celestial good... and spiritual good... are holy; for the Lord alone is holy; and what proceeds from Him is the only Holy in the Heavens and on earth. References. AE 427:7.

The reason Holiness to Jehovah was engraved on the plate of gold... was that thus it was in the sight of the whole people; hence there was what is holy in their minds when in worship; and this Holy corresponded to the Holy which is in the universal Heaven, and which is the Divine Human... for this... makes Heaven... Therefore, when this most holy thing... reigned universally in their minds, it sanctified all things of worship. AC 9933.
Therefore, the things anointed were said to be holy, and were also accounted as holy...
To sanctify = to represent the Holy itself, which is the Lord as to the Divine Human; for it is this which alone is holy; and from this is everything holy in the Heavens and on earth.

The Lord Himself is above the Heavens... (but) the Divine which proceeds thence from Him in the Heavens is what is called the Holy... This Divine, in the perception of the Angels, is the Divine Human of the Lord, which alone is the Holy that was represented.
How holy marriages are in Heaven...
Hence the Holy inflows through the Word.
Holy is he and his garments, and his sons and his sons' garments () = all the Divine things in the Heavens. Holy = what proceeds from the Lord, because He is the only Holy; thus it = what is Divine.

Thou shalt boil the flesh in the holy place () = the preparation of good for the uses of life through truths of doctrine in illustration from the Lord... In the holy place = from Divine illustration; for the holy place = where the Divine of the Lord is present.
The altar shall be the holy of holies () = the Celestial Kingdom, where the Lord is present in the good of love.

The good of the Spiritual Kingdom... is called holy; but the good of the Celestial Kingdom... the holy of holies... because by the latter good the Lord inflows immediately into the Heavens, but by spiritual good... mediately through the former.

What is holy and pious, but is not from love, is indeed heard, but is not received gratefully; for... an external Holy without an internal penetrates only to the first threshold of Heaven, and is there dissipated...
This Divine is what is called the Spirit of Jehovah, and the Holy.

The things called the holy things of the Church are not holy unless holily received; for (otherwise) the Divine does not inflow into them; and none of the holy things with man are holy except from the Divine influx. For example, sacred buildings, the altars therein, the bread and wine for the Holy Supper, become holy solely through the Lord's presence; and therefore if on account of the sins of the people the Lord cannot be present there, what is holy is absent, because what is Divine is. Moreover, the holy things of the Church are profaned by sins, because they remove what is Divine.
A Holy of Holies is this to Jehovah () = because from the Divine Celestial.
When it is called the shekel of holiness () it denotes the quantity of truth and good; for truth and good are what are called holy, because they are from the Lord, who alone is holy.
The oil of anointing of holiness () = a representative of the Lord as to the Divine Human... for this is the Holy itself in the Heavens. AC 10267:end, References. AC 10268. AC 10285.
Holy () = devoid of the falsity of evil. (Explained.)
The holy of holies it shall be to you () = because from the Lord. Holy = all that and only that which proceeds from the Lord. References.
Holy shall it be to thee to Jehovah () = that worship is to be applied to love Divine.
For what is holy () = for the Representative Church.
Holy = what is Divine in Heaven and the Church; for this alone is holy; and what is Divine in Heaven and the Church proceeds from His Divine Human; thus it is His Divine Human which alone is holy...
Because this is holy to you () = hence all the good and truth which make the Church. Holy = all that and only that which proceeds from the Lord; thus the good of love and the truth of faith...
Holy to Jehovah () = what is Divine; (for it) = His Divine Human, and all that and only that which proceeds from Him. References.

It is said separate from a holy internal, because what is external separated from what is internal is also separated from what is holy, for what is holy of man is in his internal. That is called holy which inflows with man from Heaven...
Therefore the Holy Supper is the most holy thing of the Church.

(The Israelites) could be in a holy external for the sake of themselves, which could be miraculously converted into a holy external for the sake of God by the Spirits with them, and could be received from these by the Angels, and thus be elevated into a holy internal.
When a man... in the externals of the Word... perceives what is holy within himself, there is with him an external in which is an internal; for that Holy is from the internal...
Because what is holy from Heaven inflows with them while they are reading the Word... It is perceived only as a general Holy...
A holy state on that occasion. Signified.
Hence what is holy inflows from the Angels, by which is conjunction.
This Divine truth is what is called the Holy which proceeds from Him.

He said that everyone (when hearing preaching in Heaven) is pious, devout, and holy, according to his interiors... because in these is the Holy itself, because there is the Divine of the Lord; and that he knew of no external Holy without them. When he thought of an external Holy without them, he said that perhaps it is something which counterfeits what is holy...
Marriages on earth... are most holy before the Angels. Explained.
Thus do they recede from an external Holy, and come into an internal Holy, in which worship itself truly consists.
They who have lived holily in externals... in order to be... accounted as saints after death, are not in Heaven. Described.
Such are many of the saints in the Pontifical religion...

It is believed by many that spiritual life... consists in... an external Holy... but... an external Holy without an internal Holy... does not constitute spiritual life; but... an external Holy from an internal Holy...

An external Holy... with man is not holy, unless his internal is holy... (It) is natural, and not spiritual. Hence it is that it exists equally with the evil as with the good; and they who place all worship in it are for the most part empty, that is, are devoid of the Knowledges of good and truth; and yet goods and truths are the holy things themselves which are to be known, believed, and loved, because they are from the Divine, and thus the Divine is in them. An internal Holy, therefore, is to love good and truth... and what is just and sincere (for their own sakes).
(Thus) an external Holy avails, and is accepted by the Lord, in proportion as it proceeds from an internal holy; for such as this is, such is the other.
Hence it is, that (at the Holy Supper) the Holy of love and the Holy of faith inflow from the Angels with the man; thus through Heaven from the Lord. Hence the conjunction.
That the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord is what in the Word is called the Holy. References.
(On the Roman Catholic saints there.) LJCont 61, General article. TCR 822, General article. SE 440. SE 2133. DMin 4565. LJPost 60.
That the Lord is called the Holy One of Israel. Illustrated. AE 326:3.
It is from the spiritual sense that the Word is holy in every expression. Explained.
That Divine truth in the sense of the letter of the Word is... in its Holy... General article.
By the Holy of Holies, where was the ark of the covenant, was represented... the inmost of Heaven and of the Church.

The spiritual Holy, which is the Spirit of Truth proceeding from the Lord, is within each single thing in the sense of the letter... This Holy is injured when the Word is falsified and adulterated. This is profanation.
Preface 8. (The Roman Catholic doctrine of the saints.)

He that is Holy, He that is True () = the Lord as to Divine truth... because the Lord is called Holy from his Divine truth... Hence it is that His proceeding Divine, which is the Divine truth, is called the Holy Spirit... ( = from Whom are charity and faith. AE 204.)

Holy is often mentioned... and everywhere concerning truth; and as all truth, which in itself is truth, is from good, and from the Lord, it is this truth which is called holy... Hence, those Angels who are... called spiritual are said to be holy... and in like manner men in the Church. Hence, too, it is, that the prophets and apostles are called holy; for by (them) are signified the truths of doctrine... Hence, too, it is, that the Word is called holy, because it is Divine truth; and also that the Law in the ark... is called the holy of holies. Hence, too, it is, that Jerusalem is called holy, for by Jerusalem is signified the Church which is in Divine truths. Hence, too, it is, that the altar, the Tabernacle, the garments of Aaron and his sons, were called holy after they had been anointed with oil; for oil = the good of love; and this sanctifies; and every sanctified thing relates to truth. AR 586:3. AE 204:4.
That the Lord is the only Holy, because He is the Divine truth itself. Illustrated.
From these passages it is evident, that the Truth which is from the Lord, is holiness itself, because He is the only Holy.

Holy, holy, holy. Lord God Almighty () = that the Lord is the only God, and that He alone is to be worshipped... The triplication implies all the Holy in Him alone. ( = that what is most holy proceeds from the Lord. AE 285.)
The saints () = those who are in spiritual goods and truths. AE 493.

He said he could think of a Divine Human in relation to the most holy virgin Mary... and also in relation to the saint of his monastery. Another monk said... I can rather say Divine Human of the most holy Pope...
The saints () = those of the Spiritual Kingdom.
The saints () = those who are in a life according to these things. AE 695.
The saints () = those who are in Divine truths from the Lord through the Word, and thence, abstractedly from persons, Divine truths. ( = those who are in truths from good. AE 802.)

They are called saints who live according to the truths of the Word; not that they are saints, but that the truths in them are holy; and they are holy when they are from the Lord in them; and the Lord is in them when the truths of His Word are in them. Illustrated.

Here is the patience and faith of the saints () = that the man of the Lord's New Church is explored by temptations from them as to the quality of his life and faith... The saints = those who are of the Lord's New Church; in special, those who are in Divine truths therein. AR 638. ( = the temptations... of those who become spiritual from Him. AE 813:2.) AE 893.
King of saints () = Divine truth in Heaven and the Church from Him; for by the saints are signified those who are in Divine truths from the Lord. AE 941.
Thou alone art holy () = that He is the Word, the Truth, and the Enlightenment. Explained. ( = good itself and truth itself. AE 944.)

They have shed the blood of the saints and prophets () = ... that faith alone has perverted all doctrinal truths from the Word... The saints those in the Church who are in truths; thus, abstractedly, the truths of the Church. AE 975.

The woman drunk with the blood of the saints... () = that religiosity insane from the adulterated and profaned Divine truths and goods of the Lord, of the Word, and thence of the Church... The saints = those who from the Lord through the Word are in Divine truths; and, abstractedly, the Divine truths of the Lord, of the Word, and thence of the Church. AR 801. AE 1049. AE 1193.
(Sixtus V.) said that their saints are not anything.
He said he had spoken with the saints so-called; but that they become silly when they hear and believe that they are saints. TCR 824:2.

Ye holy apostles and prophets () = the men of the Church who are in goods and truths from the Word... They are called holy, because (they) = abstractedly, the goods and truths of the Word, which in themselves are holy, because the Lord's.
The saints = those who are of the Lord's Church; and, abstractedly, the holy truths of the Church.
Babel = the profanation of what is holy.
The fine linen is the justice of the saints () = that by truths from the Word those of the Lord's Church have the goods of life. The saints = those who are of the Lord's Church. AE 1223.
Blessed and holy is he... ()... He is said to be holy who has illustration in Divine truths by conjunction with the Lord...
To encompass the camp of the saints () = to obsess and to want to destroy all things of the New Church. AR 862.
The New Jerusalem is called holy () from the Lord, who alone is holy; and from the Divine truths which are in it from the Lord out of the Word...
He that is holy let him be sanctified still () = that he who is in truths will be still more in truths.
That love truly conjugial is celestial, spiritual, holy... above every other love... General article.
The communion of the saints. TCR 307. TCR 416.
By the Holy One of Israel is meant the Lord as to the Divine Human; for the Angel said to Mary, The holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God. Illustrated. AE 328:20.
That the Decalogue was holiness itself in the Israelitish Church. Explained.
The Sabbath with the Sons of Israel was the holiness of holinesses, because it represented the Lord...
(The uselessness of the invocation of the saints.) TCR 825. SE 2802.

In Heaven... the holy things of the Church do not occupy their minds and houses any more than in the world where the worship of God is celebrated, although they occupy them more purely and interiorly.
The worship of saints is such an abomination in Heaven...
That I might learn the quality of the saints of the Papists, there were brought out from the Lower Earth as many as a hundred of them. Described.
But with the saints, so called, who are in Heaven, the case is different...
These things have been written in the presence of the saints confessing their iniquity.
Angels, Spirits, a saints... WE 541.
On the punishment of those who want to counterfeit holy things.
On those who adore nothing beyond holiness...
The holiness is twofold. Explained.
They began to sing Holy, holy... and nothing else...
